scripts.build:pages: npm run slidev -- build slides.md --base "${PAGES_BASE:-/}" --router-mode hash
scripts.export:pdf: mkdir -p dist && npm run slidev -- export slides.md --format pdf --range 1-14 --with-clicks false --output dist/The-Object-Internet-NANDA.pdf
scripts.export:pdf:full: mkdir -p dist && npm run slidev -- export slides.md --format pdf --with-clicks false --output dist/The-Object-Internet-NANDA-Full.pdf
scripts.export:pptx: mkdir -p dist && npm run slidev -- export slides.md --format pptx --range 1-14 --with-clicks false --output dist/The-Object-Internet-NANDA.pptx
scripts.export:pptx:full: mkdir -p dist && npm run slidev -- export slides.md --format pptx --with-clicks false --output dist/The-Object-Internet-NANDA-Full.pptx
scripts.export:png: mkdir -p dist && npm run slidev -- export slides.md --format png --range 1-14 --with-clicks false --output dist
